passport.title: Farm passport
passport.description: Farm details, land documents and responsible people
passport.name: Farm name
passport.overAssignedBody: The contours add up to {{area}} more than the total area. Check the areas.

map.title: Farm map
map.description: Draw fields and facilities on the map. The area is calculated automatically.
map.placePoint: Mark a facility with a point
map.drawHint: Tap the boundary points one by one: {{name}}. Press Finish when you are done.
map.pointHint: Tap the spot on the map where the facility is.
map.editHint: Drag the points to change the boundary.
map.previewArea: Estimated area: {{area}}. The exact area is calculated after saving.
map.overlap: Warning: this contour overlaps №{{number}} by {{area}}. That area counts twice in the land balance.
map.unmappedTitle: Contours not drawn on the map
map.toolsFailed: The drawing tools did not load, so the map is view-only. Try reloading the page.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: All land contours: crop fields, pasture, reserve, yard and infrastructure
fields.name: Name
fields.areaManualHint: If you draw it on the map, the area is calculated automatically.
fields.areaFromMapHint: The area is calculated from the boundary on the map.
fields.searchPlaceholder: Search by number, name or soil
fields.emptyBody: Draw your fields on the map, or enter their area by hand.
fields.archiveBody: {{name}} leaves the list. Its history and costs are kept.
fields.noCropBody: Crop plans are assigned in the Crops section.
fields.rotationEmptyBody: Crops, yield and cost for the last 5 years appear here.

soil.trendHint: Pick an indicator to see how it changes over the years.
soil.emptyBody: Enter laboratory results and their trend appears here.
soil.deleteBody: The analysis of {{date}} will be deleted.

facilities.title: Facilities
facilities.description: Barn, stores, water, power, roads and the irrigation network
facilities.name: Name
facilities.parentHint: For a section, choose the barn it belongs to.
facilities.emptyBody: Add the barn, stores and other facilities, or draw them on the map.
facilities.archiveBody: {{name}} leaves the list. Records linked to it are kept.

irrigation.name: Name
irrigation.limitHint: Yearly limit. Actual use comes from the irrigation journal.
irrigation.emptyBody: Add canals, ditches, pumps and pipes, and link them to fields.
irrigation.deleteBody: {{name}} will be removed from the network.

documents.title: Document archive
documents.description: Land, construction, permits and contracts. Those about to expire come first.
documents.expiryHint: Leave empty if it does not expire.
documents.emptyBody: Add a document and you will be reminded before it expires.
documents.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be deleted from the archive.

weather.title: Weather forecast
weather.emptyBody: The weather updates automatically every 6 hours.
weather.unavailable: The weather service is not responding. It will update automatically later.
